structured.feedback: The description is about 200 words in Markdown with clear subheadings. It separates features from benefits, ends with a call to action, and leaves out weaknesses, links and invented quotes. Its claims are hedged ("helps lift") and come from the product details. Minor flaws are the unsupported "lock in hydration" line and the thin unique selling points.
